name: merchline
description: Merchline: product data explorer with Claude-powered trace-to-season queries (Angular, Node.js, PostgreSQL).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run db" "wait-on -t 120000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5433 && npm run api" "wait-on -t 180000 tcp:127.0.0.1:3000 && npm run web"
